name: Whispers from the Star
source: Save a stranded astronaut on a mysterious alien planet through real-time AI conversations, where your words are her only lifeline. Guide her through Gaia's dangers and forge an enduring bond in this interactive story with voice-controlled, open-ended dialogue.
translation: 通过实时人工智能对话拯救一名被困在神秘外星的宇航员，你的话语是她唯一的生命线。在这个通过语音控制、开放式对话的互动故事中，引导她度过盖亚的危险并建立持久的联系。
